text:
maria: Quick weekly capacity readout — spotted a tightening window next Tue-Wed from APAC -> EU. Need a short decision on spot mix and batch window shifts by EOD.
sameer: saw the spike in telemetry. APAC cluster (apac-2) is up ~62% week-over-week for pipelined chat workloads. Forecasted GPU-hours next week: APAC: 8.4k, EU: 11.2k, US: 18.7k. Numbers include scheduled training hooks.
oliver: can you paste the per-cluster runway? I want to see preemptible risk for apac-2 specifically.
maria: apac-2 runway: 24h at current burn if we keep spot at 40%. If we drop to 25% spot, runway extends to ~40h. EU clusters have ~72h runway with current mix.
jen: tagging cost note — if we reduce spot by 15% across APAC, estimated extra cost is ~$24k/week but reduces preempt risk for latency-critical routes.
li: suggestion — move non-urgent batch reranks to off-peak (02:00-06:00 UTC) for EU to shave peak load by ~9%. That's about 1.0k GPU-hours shift.
paul: any networking constraints if we shift more to EU? Last week we hit egress bursts during the cross-region fallback test.
maria: yes — if we route more jobs to eu-west, watch the NAT gateway throughput. infra-bot logged a warning: "nat-gw-eu-west throughput 81%" yesterday.
infra-bot: [automated] deploy-alert: nat-gw-eu-west exceeded 80% bandwidth for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Recommend: enable additional NAT pods or stagger large shuffles.
sameer: quick action plan proposal:
- Short term (today): reduce APAC spot to 25% for latency routes, move non-critical batch to off-peak EU window.
- Mid term (48h): spin up 2x temporary eu-west NAT pods, and add 80 GPU hours of reserved capacity in apac-2 to cover canary traffic.
- Monitoring: add burnrate alert at 65k GPU-hours/day aggregate.
oliver: thumbs up on the plan. Two small asks: 1) can we cap experimental-model traffic to 10% of apac-2 during the window? 2) add a canary routing rule: if p95 latency > 380ms, fallback to dedicated-eu-1.
maria: yes on both. Jen/Finance — any blockers for adding the 80 GPU reserved for apac-2?
jen: I can approve up to $30k emergency weekly for capacity without board OK. 80 GPUs for 48h is ~ $12k — OK.
li: I'll open the PR to change scheduling and the autoscaler snippet here for visibility:

```
autoscaler:
  minNodes: 4
  maxNodes: 18
  scaleUpCPUThreshold: 0.7
  spotMix: 0.25
  preemptibleFallback: true
```
paul: I'll coordinate the NAT pod rollout and confirm cloud quotas. ETA ~ 90m.
maria: thanks — summary: implement sameer plan, rotate batches tonight, reserve 80 GPUs, reduce APAC spot to 25% for latency routes, cap experiment traffic. We'll meet 10:30am tomorrow for post-change burn and latency readout. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: [automated] runbook-note: created incident-ops ticket #INC-8742 for NAT scaling task."
